title: Vanilla+(Create edition)
description: This Modpack includes some vanilla+ friendly village and biome mods and adds for those who can't live without it the Create mod
body: Vanilla+(create edition) is designed for players who want to expand Minecraft's potential without losing its classic charm. This pack balances the mechanical genius of the Create mod with a beautifully overhauled world and top-tier performance optimizations. Whether you're building a massive automated train network or exploring revamped vanilla biomes, this pack offers a smooth, polished experience.
